description: This source file defines the 'MacNodeLocationService' class, which manages location updates using CoreLocation for a macOS application. It implements location request handling with support for timeouts and error management.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A final class handling location services on macOS, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate and LocationServiceCommon, providing asynchronous location requests with timeout support.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout parameters.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: A generic method to perform an async operation with a timeout, cancelling the operation if the timeout elapses.
